_comment: DMT — light blue. NEW tenant, added from Figma DS V2 'DMT' mode 2026-08-25 (docs/figma-color-extraction.md); modeled identically to the other tenant files (fams/iwmp/ead/uccp) — same flat `primary-50..900` / `surface-secondary` / `transparent-brand-20|40|60` key shape, read by style-dictionary.config.js's buildTenantsCss() the same way. One documented Figma bug NOT propagated — see surface-secondary $description. No demo-environment tenant manifest/modules/seeds exist for dmt yet (design-system-only tenant, out of scope for the demo repo per this changeset).

secondary-foreground-strong.$description: Same fix as uccp.tokens.json (designer report 2026-09-07, generic enum dot-chip legibility) — this tenant shares the identical `secondary` (#667085) solid-fill/white-text pairing, so it inherited the same latent bug (core's navy `secondary-foreground-strong` alias against a dark tenant `secondary` fill). Reuses this tenant's own `secondary-foreground` (white), mirroring the dark-theme mirror's own approach.

surface-secondary.$description: DMT's OWN 50 step. Figma's 'Surface/Secondary' for the DMT mode is mis-bound to Qatar MME/Primary/50 (#F9EBEF, a pink) — see docs/figma-color-extraction.md §4.1. NOT propagated: uses DMT/50 here instead, which is what the binding should point to.

success-text.$description: D-6: explicit override slot, set to the CORE alias (color.success-text = success-scale.700) — DMT has no green brand ramp of its own to prefer. 5.41:1 on white (this tenant's card/background are unoverridden core values).

error-text.$description: D-6: explicit override slot, set to the CORE alias (color.error-text = error.700) — DMT has no red/error ramp of its own. 6.57:1 on white.
